notes: Populated 23 Aug 2026 from each brand's live TikTok and Instagram profiles (pinned/most recent videos + Reels); refreshed 4 Sep 2026 with each brand's latest Reel/TikTok as of that date (older entries kept below for history). postedAt is the video's actual upload date — decoded from the video ID for TikTok, read off the post itself for Instagram. Instagram entries carry a thumbnail (a real frame captured from the post, since Instagram's embed widget needs Meta API access N4 doesn't have) — swap assets/videos/ig-<brand>.jpg for a fresh capture whenever the video changes. Add a new entry whenever a fresh video goes up — platform must be 'tiktok' or 'instagram' for the embed to render automatically. The site always sorts videos by postedAt (newest first), so just add entries in any order.
